confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bangkok price levels for a July 2026 window, not checked against live menus, booking pages, or current listings. Beer and restaurant anchors are the most reliable; hostel and hotel anchors vary widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine rest on weaker direct recall and are set at roughly three times the draft-beer anchor, using the local price relationship to beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional SEA basis: Bangkok is treated as a large, tourist-heavy Southeast Asian capital, with price levels placed roughly alongside peers such as Kuala Lumpur and Ho Chi Minh City. Hotel and hostel anchors reflect central tourist and business districts rather than the cheapest outer areas.
